IMPERIAL COURIER INTELLIGENCE DOSSIER
RECONNAISSANCE HEADQUARTERS - ADVANCE SOLODA VANTAGE
COURIER REGISTRATION: imperial_courier_adwa
===============================================================================

HISTORICAL INCIDENT REPORT:
A swift royal messenger riding from Emperor Menelik II's headquarters camp at
Adwa was intercepted near the Italian lines at Mount Raio. The messenger carried
an illuminated parchment depicting the Imperial Lion of Judah and the tri-color
standard.

General Baratieri's intelligence officers examined the image visually but failed
to discover any legible battle plans.

However, our undercover scouts inside the colonial camp report that the document
contains dual-layered cryptographic hiding techniques:
  1. A low-order channel signal embedded within the pixel raster itself.
  2. An encrypted secondary payload container concealed beyond the boundary
     of the standard visual image container.

RECOVER THE EMPEROR'S SECRET WAR PROCLAMATION AND EXTRACT THE ROYAL FLAG!
